input_units: CSS viewport pixels multiplied by the admitted native scale; exact root-document target and unobscured point required
delivery: One generic motion event to the owned WebView. No touch, button, focus, DOM mouse-event synthesis or pointer release is added.
qualification: Source review and protocol checks do not qualify an installed provider. Framework isTrusted, CSS hover, exact coordinates/target, no clicks and unchanged focus must pass separately. Overall Android automation stays disabled.
